note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with destination (Durban South Africa), HS codes 76151030 and 82159900 and BOL number 1136885, plus aggregated buyer volumes for Russia (1961), Australia (1360) and USA (1003/905). Declared HS set 732393;732399;732690;761510 is consistent with observed 76151030 (aluminium household articles) but the observed 82159900 (cutlery/spoons) is NOT in the declared set — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; record actual HS as 76151030 + 82159900 and flag the declared set as incomplete. Domestic supply evidence could not be established: no GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP tender award and no annual-report split was retrievable — zaubacorp returned HTTP 403, eximpedia returned HTTP 403, volza returned HTTP 403, DuckDuckGo/Bing searches returned no relevant hits (Bing returned only generic 'King' brand results). Domestic status therefore 'unknown', not 'none_found': absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic sales. Revenue and export volume figures: null — ImportKey shows shipment counts only, no value data in free view; not invented. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is inconsistent with the observed product lines (aluminium kitchen/household articles, cutlery) — actual segment is houseware/kitchenware metal goods, not food/FMCG.
